speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with sudden-onset lower back pain radiating down your leg; to help me identify the cause, please describe exactly where the pain travels, what makes it worse, and if you are experiencing any numbness or weakness in your leg or foot.

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Disc Herniation (likely L5-S1). The sudden onset of sharp lower back pain radiating down the leg and into the foot during exercise is highly characteristic of an acute disc herniation. Given your young age and the specific radiation pattern, do you have any loss of sensation in the foot or weakness in lifting your big toe? REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_Spine_MRI
